items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: No, he had a ballroom. He used to call me to play the piano for them.

ctx.x: Was he a piano player? I don't know.
No, he had a ballroom. He used to call me to play the piano for them. He was like a tunk, you know. He'd dance and that shit.
Did you run out of tape, Conor?
